description: This file implements SHA-256 hashing functions, including a hasher class, utility functions, and the main SHA256 function, with internal constants and bitwise operations.

classes.name: Sha256Hasher
classes.description: A class that performs SHA-256 hashing on data chunks, maintaining internal state and producing the final hash.

methods.name: Sha256
methods.description: Computes the SHA-256 hash of the input string view.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Processes a 64-byte chunk of data to update the hash state.

methods.name: Finalize
methods.description: Completes the hashing process by padding the remaining data and producing the final hash output.
